tier_reason: Lowered C to D. Enricher e120 (2026-10-05) found the only harness in the repo, tests/benchmark.cpp: it is commented out of the build, its template is a Fibonacci placeholder, and its single decode case feeds dice.png (a PNG) to qoi::decode, which parses as width 218,765,834, height 13, 73 channels and requests about 207.6 GB, so nothing meaningful was ever timed with it. The code is a scalar port of qoi.h with a zero-filled worst-case buffer and a shrink_to_fit copy, while qoixx's own README shows 1.4-1.7x over qoi.h, so the 'about 20% encode / 30% decode faster than qoixx' remark in issue #1 (no code, compiler, flags, qoixx version or repeat counts, from a live webcam ROS node) is implausible from the code. Directional remark without methodology: D.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Issue #1 (2022-07-24, by awesomebytes, author of the ROS PRs): 'About 20% faster to encode and about 30% faster to decode' than qoixx, 640x480 30 fps webcam stream, i7-10875H; no methodology, and implausible from the code (scalar qoi.h port with extra copies, while qoixx reports 1.4-1.7x over qoi.h). ROS image_transport_plugins PRs #103 and #104 report QOI compression at 28% CPU and decompression at 13% CPU keeping 640x480 at 30 fps against PNG transport above 100% CPU at 3 fps; these are CPU-load observations of a transport plugin, not a benchmark. The repo's own tests/benchmark.cpp is disabled and broken (its decode case feeds a PNG to qoi::decode).
corrections.caveats: One informal third-party comment with no benchmark code, compiler, flags, qoixx version, image content or repeat counts. The repo's tests/benchmark.cpp is commented out of the build, uses a Fibonacci placeholder template, and its only decode case feeds dice.png (a PNG) to qoi::decode, which parses as a 218,765,834 x 13 x 73-channel image and asks for about 207.6 GB. Security: decode has no run-length bound check (heap overflow of up to 61 pixels on crafted input, relevant to the ROS network use), 1- or 2-channel decode overruns by 2 bytes, get_header reads out of bounds on inputs under 14 bytes, sizes use 32-bit arithmetic with no pixel cap; QOI_HEADER_ONLY appears broken (code reading); the fuzz target covers get_header only with ASAN off. Neither ROS PR was merged. README calls it work in progress. Last commit 2022-09-07.
